barrier.resolver: every loaded directory, --out and --snapshot pass both SEG-075's refuse_sealed and SEG-076's fail-closed sealed_target (both slash conventions, nonexistent paths, case-folded)
barrier.seg072_sealed_cohort: already exposed; not used and never presented as independent evidence
barrier.seg075_reserved_cohort: sealed, never read, fitted, scored or used for selection

genesis.M4_DENSE_ens@128: SEG-072 M4 seeds 1-3 word-logit mean, cell max at 128 (ensemble; reported separately, never used to judge B/C)
genesis.M4_DENSE_s1@128: SEG-072 M4 seed 1 alone, cell max at 128 bytes (the single-seed comparator matched to the pilots)

comparators.xplat: SEG-075 T004 C0-all scores of M3-R s49, M1-HGB, M4-Dense s1 and the 3-seed ensemble; M3_FROZEN by inference with the production weights

condition.name: Genesis-only training
condition.why: matched to the preserved, bit-reproduced SEG-072 C0 fold scores of M3-R (seed 49), M4-Dense (seeds 1-3) and M1-HGB; C2 is not run in T001

expansion_rule.meaning: the class only decides whether SEG-076-T002's multi-seed compute is justified; a single seed cannot establish architectural superiority or inferiority in either direction
expansion_rule.text: A model in {B, C} qualifies iff, against the best one-seed comparator (lowest Genesis mean ER among M4-Dense seed 1 @128, M3-R seed 49 and A; ties: fewer B50 misses, then that order): Genesis mean ER lower by >= 0.02; no lineage max ER worse by more than 0.05; no more boundary-stratum missed cells at B50; no more total B50 misses. Qualifying set {} -> NEGATIVE_STOP, {B} -> EXPAND_B, {C} -> EXPAND_C, {B,C} -> EXPAND_B_AND_C. Applied once, never tuned. A model with any failed planned Genesis fit does not qualify.

folds.all: one fit on all 11 Genesis lineages per model: preserves the weights and scores the four cross-platform development representatives (toslibc, emutos, BattleIsleEditor, amiga-realtime3d) as evaluation only (under C0 no cross-platform data trains, so xplat_lolo fits would equal this fit)

metrics.boundary_strata: positive cells holding any D byte; positive cells adjacent to a D-only cell; positive cells with <= 8 starts; their union ('boundary'); missed cells at B35/B50 and normalized rank quantiles q50/q90/q100
metrics.budgets: B35/B50/B60 missed starts and missed positive cells; negative cells admitted at B50
metrics.code: segarecomp_xplat_explore_eval.image_metrics_ext / lineage_summary / summary (calls SEG-075's unchanged image_metrics and lineage_rows)
metrics.determinism: A, B and C are refitted once on fold D05 into a separate directory; scores must be bitwise identical (reported; a mismatch is disclosed, it does not change the class)
metrics.er: SEG-075 per-image excess retention on informative images; per lineage max ER (primary) and mean image ER
metrics.frf: retention needed for source-backed full recall (per image; lineage max/mean)
metrics.genesis_mean_er: mean over the 11 lineages of the lineage max ER (SEG-075 definition)
metrics.secondary: AUROC (mean per lineage), cost (wall / CPU seconds per fit, per-image inference seconds, peak RSS)

architecture.message_passing: 2 rounds per layer, 3 typed candidate edge sets, PROVEN flag

models.order: A first (all folds), then B and C on identical folds; B is not required to beat A before C is trained; no result of A cancels B or C

outputs.private: <HARNESS_ROOT>/.cache/seg076/t001 (scores, weights, records, logs; ignored, never committed)

relation_to_seg075: new experiment by explicit operator direction (2026-10-20); SEG-075-T005's gate does not apply; SEG-075's decision (DATA_INSUFFICIENT, ADR 0163), plan, results and sealed cohort are unchanged and not reinterpreted

resources.backend: CPU (research venv torch 2.14.1 CPU execution) for every T001 fit, the reproducibility baseline
resources.failure: a fit that exceeds its cap, its RSS limit or raises is recorded failed; a model with any failed planned Genesis fit is 'missing or failed fits' in the expansion rule (no advantage); no retry with other hyperparameters, steps or seeds
resources.infrastructure_rerun: at most one, only for an infrastructure cause (host / process killed externally, not a cap or a model error), identical configuration and seed, recorded in the farm state with its reason
resources.probe: pre-freeze cost probe (40 training steps on the all-Genesis set, no scores): B 0.39 s/step (~26 min/fit at 4000 steps), C 0.81 s/step (~54 min/fit), A features 3.4 s for all Genesis images; peak RSS A 0.8 / B 1.0 / C 1.4 GB

rocm_benchmark.decision: CPU. Deciding reason: the same-backend clause. Every comparator the expansion rule uses (M4-Dense seed 1, M3-R, A) is a CPU result, and CPU and ROCm outputs are not bit-identical (ADR 0117), so a ROCm B or C would be an unmatched comparison (and splitting B onto ROCm, C onto CPU, would also confound the B-vs-C contrast; it would save ~50 min). Throughput context: all B and C fits in one ROCm process take ~0.55 h + ~7.2-7.8 h versus ~2.7-2.9 h on the 6-process CPU farm; several concurrent ROCm processes (which could suit C's CPU-bound edge building) were not measured. A later stage may pre-register its own ROCm decision.
rocm_benchmark.environment: torch 2.6.0+rocm6.4.2 (HIP 6.4.43484), AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT gfx1201 via WSL2 /dev/dxg; benchmark only, no scores
rocm_benchmark.method: unchanged B/C network and M4 recipe, all-Genesis training set, seed 1, median step time after 5 warm-up steps; B 60 steps x 3 repeats, C 40 steps x 2 repeats; parameter hash after the run compared across repeats

C.note: C's typed message passing builds per-edge index lists in Python, so the step stays CPU-bound

rocm_benchmark.rule: SEG-072 hardware rule (ADR 0153): ROCm only if >= 25% end-to-end improvement over the parallel CPU farm AND reproducible, with every compared candidate on the same backend

threads.A: sklearn default (OpenMP), the farm sets OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
